target: Clinician/custodian-verified first symptom onset of a qualified exacerbation in (decision_time, decision_time + 7 days]
alternate_recorded_care_endpoint: Requires an explicit separately predeclared protocol; never rename care dates to symptom onset
negative_rule: Full future horizon inside verified complete surveillance, labels mature at dataset cutoff and no qualified episode; otherwise unknown
data_entry_requirements: source provenance and permitted use documented
physical device/context and measured availability or verified bounds
episode handling, recovery and recurrent events specified
reserved independent confirmation patients or cohort before any fitting
partition: Patient-disjoint training/validation/confirmation; fit transforms only on training. Longitudinal same-patient evaluation, if additionally done, reported separately
candidate_feature_views: static history plus past-only patient trends
history plus trends plus direct available symptom diary
selection: Freeze exact grid, patient folds, seeds, missing-data processing and selection metric only after receiving and qualifying data, before model search. No deep-learning search justified by current evidence
threshold: Specify acceptable alert workload with clinician/workflow review before fitting; select threshold on validation only. Do not tune on current frozen tests
evaluation: average precision against prevalence and history baselines
all-event sensitivity with no-opportunity events retained
false alerts per patient-time and repeated-alert cooldown
success_rule: Must exceed prespecified baselines with useful recall/precision/coverage and workload; declare exact operating targets with reviewers before fitting. Overall accuracy alone is insufficient
desired_80_percent: User aspiration, not achieved performance or an invented guaranteed success criterion
previous_exposure: Prior real and synthetic test outcomes and the current TOLIFE release audit have been inspected. Do not re-label their re-evaluation as fresh independent validation
